label: SOMA skeleton, as MotionBricks uses it
notes: The 77-joint SOMA skeleton MotionBricks loads (root Hips; metres, +Y up, facing +Z, +X the character's left). SOMA names the hip joint LeftLeg/RightLeg and the knee LeftShin/RightShin. Unmapped, at no landmark: Spine2 (between spine and chest), Neck2, HeadEnd, Jaw, LeftEye, RightEye, LeftToeEnd, RightToeEnd. Unmapped because MotionBricks gives them no motion of their own: every finger joint (Left/Right HandThumb1-3, HandIndex1-4, HandMiddle1-4, HandRing1-4, HandPinky1-4 and their End joints). The model predicts no finger; MotionBricks decodes the fingers at the reference pose (a flat T-pose hand) and its endpoint correction only blends them from the last context pose to the first target pose, so the receiving rig keeps its own finger animation.
